raw_text:
Sixth review of run r-20260921T053228459971-node-probe (plan imas-ambix:serve-telemetry-spine
section 3), read at its round-six head 6c9a9019fffa023b3a7b44d1eb5dd7bcc1f56a5a on base
39e7bba5. The fifth review, at b9bbdeb0, scored 94 and reported one defect: the expected
card-query vector was derived from node_probe.CARD_QUERY_FIELDS, the constant under test, so an
edit to a query spelling travelled with the expectation and asserted nothing. The repair is
2d02965c, which writes the query vector and the squeue format out literally and ties them back to
the module in one labelled test; 6c9a9019 records its landing. This review re-scores the landed
change, in this reviewer's own scratch copy of both files, in the repository's shared project
environment; nothing here ran on a GPU node or against a live serve.

VERDICT goal: the round's goal is that an edit to the wire the probe composes be caught by the
suite rather than travelling with it, and it is met by measurement. Dropping temperature.gpu from
CARD_QUERY_FIELDS (one filter added to the composition at node_probe.py:78) takes the suite from
35 passed to 3 failed, 32 passed, the three being test_the_probe_gives_its_own_timeout_to_every_source_it_reads
and test_the_job_read_carries_the_bound_it_declares_rather_than_the_local_one, each on a KeyError
naming the literal card vector the recording runner answers, and
test_the_literal_queries_are_the_ones_the_module_composes, on the equality at
tests/test_node_probe.py:562 with "At index 2 diff: 'temperature.gpu' != 'power.draw'".
VERDICT done_when: the dispatched measure is this record; it is stored parsed at the fenced path
with all five dimensions scored in 0..20 and the revision named, and the run's logs hold the
mutation evidence above, so the measure is met rather than asserted.
VERDICT write_paths: the reviewed commits stay inside the node's declared paths -- 2d02965c touches
tests/test_node_probe.py alone (+58/-5) and 6c9a9019 the plan and its landing record alone -- and
node_probe.py at this head hashes f78e35a9..., byte-identical to b9bbdeb0, which is what a
test-only repair requires. This reviewer wrote only the fenced record path, with its scratch and
logs under its own run directory.

VERDICT manifest: read; its control paragraph declares that the plugin
mutate_card_fields.py drops temperature.gpu from CARD_QUERY_FIELDS and gives 3 failed, 32 passed
against the fixed file and 34 of 34 pass against the pre-fix file, and both halves reproduce here
by an independent route -- a filter added to the composition gives exactly 3 failed, 32 passed at
6c9a9019, and the pre-repair test file taken from b9bbdeb0 (519 lines) gives 34 passed, exit 0
against that same mutated module, which is the defect the repair closes, measured on both sides.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit; 2d02965c adds the literal field list, the literal card argv
and the literal squeue format (tests/test_node_probe.py:127-150), routes the recorded card and job
vectors through them, and adds one coupling test at :545-564 that states the literals are the
module's current output and that this is the only derived expectation; 6c9a9019 records the
finding, the fix and the control on the landing record.

SCORE goal_fidelity: 20
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: the wire the probe composes is asserted against written-out vectors at
tests/test_node_probe.py:138-150 rather than derived from node_probe.CARD_QUERY_FIELDS, and both
directions the dispatch names are red in this reviewer's runs -- a dropped field gives 3 failed, 32
passed and a reordered pair 3 and 5 failed -- against a baseline of 35 passed at this head.
SCORE evidence: 19
JUSTIFICATION evidence: every claim above is a run in the reviewer's own scratch shadow copy,
guarded by a collection-time assert that refuses to collect unless the import resolves inside that
copy, and the round-five defect was reproduced before being credited -- the pre-repair file gives
34 passed, exit 0, against the same dropped-field module that now reddens three tests; docked one
point for the residuals the record itself discloses, the card body being a recorded-shape fixture
rather than a capture and section 3's under-one-percent-of-one-core clause being unmeasured.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: 2d02965c touches tests/test_node_probe.py alone (+58/-5) and
6c9a9019 the plan and its landing record alone, both inside the node's declared paths, with
node_probe.py hashing f78e35a9 unchanged from b9bbdeb0, and this reviewer wrote only the fenced
record path.
SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: five of the six mutations red at the literals, and the sixth measures the
one over-fire I could construct -- an edit that changes no byte of the wire but makes
CARD_QUERY_FIELDS a list reddens only the equality at tests/test_node_probe.py:562 (1 failed, 34
passed), so the pin is type-strict and a wire-preserving container refactor costs a reader a
diagnosis; docked for that, and for the fixture residual.
SCORE fit: 19
JUSTIFICATION fit: ruff --no-cache exits 0 over both files at 6c9a9019 and the naming scans are
clean, the two scan hits at tests/test_node_probe.py:78 and :356 being a captured job name inside
fixture data, the same pair the prior round read and kept; the repair keeps the file's idiom, a
declared figure being the one in force, stated in the docstring at tests/test_node_probe.py:118-126.

NOTES, item 2: the literal does not object to a legitimate change, and the one I measured is
read_cards being handed the same vector written out literally instead of composed from the
constant, which leaves the suite at 35 passed. No FINDING line is emitted here, and none is
withheld for want of a candidate: every mutation I could construct that changes a byte of the wire
reddens the suite, and the one that reddens with the wire unchanged is reported above as a
strictness cost, not a defect, because it fails in the safe direction.

NOTES, item 3: the literal and the constant are still asserted to agree, at
tests/test_node_probe.py:562-564, and the three lines' unique catch is the container refactor
measured above: with the wire intact and the constant a list, that equality is the only line in
the suite that objects, because every other assertion observes the composed string rather than the
constant.
NOTES, item 4: the only module-naming expectations left in tests/test_node_probe.py are the
class-default middle terms at :539-542, each chained on its own line to a literal (== 15.0, ==
10.0) so a default change is still caught by the literal beside it, and the coupling test's own
:558/562/564; every other node_probe reference in the file is a call under test, not an
expectation. The dispatched sibling name tests/test_node_probe_prefix.py does not exist in this
tree -- git ls-files gives tests/test_agent_router_prefix_probe.py and
tests/test_agent_router_prefix_repair.py -- and both of those contain zero node_probe references.
NOTES, item 5: the naming scans are clean over both files, with no plan label, ticket reference,
version suffix, changelog prose or author attribution in any name, comment or docstring, and the
two scan hits are the fixture payload named in the fit justification.
